findings.hypothesis_result: Additional runtime workers were slower in these controls; a fixed worker ceiling with unchanged per-operation storage latency is contradicted. Synchronous SQL write/commit latency rises as worker pool size rises; durability and filesystem contention are stronger leads. No exclusive fsync, physical-device, or causal storage-role attribution established.
